---
title: "Handle SDK Responses"
description: "Handle errors and response outcomes predictably using AptosResult in Kaptos."
sidebar:
  label: "Response Handling"
---

All operations return `AptosResult<T>`, which models either `Success` or `Failure`. This ensures explicit error handling.

### Using `when` expression

```kotlin
when (val result = aptos.ledger.info()) {
  is AptosResult.Success -> println("Ledger version: ${result.value.version}")
  is AptosResult.Failure -> println("Error: ${result.error.message}")
}
```

### Extension functions

- `.map { }` - transform success value
- `.flatMap { }` - chain another AptosResult operation
- `.fold(onSuccess = {}, onFailure = {})` - reduce to a single result type
- `.getOrNull()` - returns value or null
- `.getOrElse { fallback }` - returns value or derives fallback from error
- `.onSuccess { }` - side effect on success, returns result unchanged
- `.onFailure { }` - side effect on failure, returns result unchanged
- `.isSuccess` / `.isFailure` - boolean checks

```kotlin
val version = aptos.ledger.info()
  .map { it.version }
  .getOrElse { 0UL }
```

```kotlin
aptos.faucet.fund(alice.accountAddress, 100_000_000UL)
  .onSuccess { println("Funded successfully") }
  .onFailure { println("Funding failed: ${it.message}") }
```

```kotlin
val balance = aptos.accounts.getBalance(address, asset)
  .fold(
    onSuccess = { "Balance: $it" },
    onFailure = { "Error: ${it.message}" },
  )
```

### Error categories (AptosError)

`AptosError` is a sealed interface with several variants:

- `AptosError.Transport` - network/HTTP errors
- `AptosError.Api` - REST API errors (includes `errorCode`, optional `vmErrorCode`)
- `AptosError.Indexer` - GraphQL/indexer errors
- `AptosError.Validation` - client-side validation failures
- `AptosError.Serialization` - BCS/JSON encoding errors
- `AptosError.Crypto` - key generation or signing errors
- `AptosError.Timeout` - request or wait timeouts
- `AptosError.Cancelled` - operation cancelled
- `AptosError.UnsupportedFeature` - feature not available

```kotlin
when (val result = aptos.transactions.submitAndWait(signer, payload)) {
  is AptosResult.Success -> println("Confirmed")
  is AptosResult.Failure -> when (result.error) {
    is AptosError.Api -> println("API error: ${result.error.errorCode}")
    is AptosError.Timeout -> println("Timed out")
    else -> println("Other: ${result.error.message}")
  }
}
```
